about: Describes what this project needs on a new PC. Used by migrate\register_project.ps1 (registers the project on this PC), migrate\pack_project.ps1 (old PC) and unpack_project.ps1 (new PC). Parts are packed and restored in 'order'. 'include' paths are relative to the project folder; 'external' paths are absolute paths on the old PC and are restored under <project>\archive.
name: nsedataengine
description: NSEDATAENGINE - NSE equity daily dataset (source of truth for NSEALGOENGINE and NSEMLENGINE): updater (data\), 5-year fresh build (data_fresh\), reference data (data_ref\). Folders and columns: contract\schema.yaml

parts.name: scripts
parts.why: All code, settings and the migration tools. Tiny. Includes contract\schema.yaml, the column contract (source of truth for every parquet column).

parts.name: updater_state
parts.why: Master store (all adjusted prices 1991 -> today), market table and the update logs / corporate-action ledger. Cannot be recreated without the original historical file plus a full re-download.

parts.name: fresh_build_state
parts.why: 5-year build from NSE: raw store with original NSE values, market table, audit trail. Recreatable from the cache (part 4) by re-running the build. Also the data_ref datasets (sectors, delivery, deals, insider, surveillance, shareholding, pledge, index_changes): surveillance / pledge / index history exists only here, NSE does not publish it. Also data\preopen (NSE pre-open snapshots, recorded from the first run - no history exists elsewhere).

parts.name: download_cache
parts.why: Every NSE file downloaded so far. Saves hours of re-downloading and protects against NSE removing old files from its archive.

parts.name: feature_files
parts.why: The large feature files. Rebuilt in a few minutes with 'python nse_updater.py features' / 'python nse_fresh_build.py build', so normally not moved.

parts.name: historical_archive
parts.why: The original files this project started from (needed only to re-run 'init' from scratch). Restored under <project>\archive.

setup.about: Steps run by migrate\setup_new_pc.ps1 on a new PC, in this folder. {python} = the Python on PATH (the one the scheduled task uses), {root} = this folder, {datahome} = NSEDATAENGINE folder.

steps.name: accurate PC clock (Windows Time service, asks for Administrator)
Wi-Fi card never switched off to save power + startup task PX13-KeepWifiOn (asks for Administrator)
scheduled task 'NSEDATAENGINE-PreOpen' (Mon-Fri 08:58, records the pre-open auction; asks for your Windows password)
NSE sector of every stock (data_ref\sectors.parquet + NSEALGOENGINE sector map)
delivery %, bulk/block deals, insider trades, short selling, margin trading history if not moved (45-90 min)
steps.run: if not exist data_ref\insider.parquet {python} nse_alt_data.py backfill --start 2019-01-01

steps.name: ASM/GSM lists, shareholding, pledge, index members (today)
intraday features from the 1-minute archive, if not moved (data_ref\intraday_daily.parquet, a few minutes)

notes: Feature files are not moved by default: rebuild with 'python nse_updater.py features' (minutes).
